caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: Foundry crates, on market stalls. Someone here deals with the machines.

caelen2.speaker: ORION
caelen2.text: Then someone here knows the way in and out of the Foundry. We follow the crates.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: My order calls the Cities godless. They look like people trying to stay lit.

seraphine2.speaker: ORION
seraphine2.text: Lanterns on every stall. Here, light is something you can buy.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: Home. Mind your pockets. Half this market is honest, and the other half is hungry.

nimue3.speaker: NIMUE
nimue3.text: Someone here sold them to the line. I mean to find out who.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: The Lantern Cities. Stay close. Not everyone here wants to be found.

caelen.speaker: ORION
caelen.text: Ratborn. They are not machines, Caelen. They are hungry.

seraphine.speaker: ORION
seraphine.text: Ratborn. They are not machines. They are hungry.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: Ratborn. Drain kids, grown up hungry. They take anything that isn't held tight.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: Ratborn. They are not machines. They are hungry.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: Locks on a canal. Somebody here charges for water too.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: Every gate on this canal has a price painted on it.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: The Toll Canal. Runners swam it at night so nobody could make them pay.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: The Toll Canal. Every gate here is paid for.

open.speaker: ORION
open.text: That plate opens the first gate and shuts the second. I will hold it while you pass, then step off.

after.speaker: ORION
after.text: Someone always stays behind at a toll. I will find you after.

open.speaker: ORION
open.text: The gate wants both lamps burning at once, and neither burns for long. Light one, and run for the other.

caelen.speaker: ORION
caelen.text: Night Weavers keep these roofs. If you see two of one, one of them is not there.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: Two of the same figure, on two roofs at once.

seraphine2.speaker: ORION
seraphine2.text: A Night Weaver. One of them is not there. Strike the one that does not flicker.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: The roofs are the only road nobody charges for.

nimue2.speaker: NIMUE
nimue2.text: Watch for Weavers. If you see two of one, one of them is lying.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: Night Weavers keep these roofs. If you see two of one, one of them is not there.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: More Foundry crates. Whoever trades with the machines ships from here.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: Sanctuary bread on those crates. Ours. Sold here at three times what it cost us.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: The Cinder Docks. Every crate here pays the Cinder King twice. Once in coin, once in fear.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: The Cinder Docks. Everything that is bought in this city passes through here.

caelen.speaker: CINDER KING
caelen.text: A Foundry man, in my vault. Did they send you to settle their account?

caelen2.speaker: CAELEN
caelen2.text: I came to see who was buying.

seraphine.speaker: CINDER KING
seraphine.text: The Dawnfaith's voice. Your sanctuaries sell me their bread, Oracle. Did you know?

nimue.speaker: CINDER KING
nimue.text: Little Nimue. You run my roads and you never pay the toll.

neutral.speaker: CINDER KING
neutral.text: Everyone who comes down here wants something. Everything has a price.

price.speaker: CINDER KING
price.text: Everything has a price. Even light. Especially light.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: Foundry seals, Dawnfaith seals, city seals. Everyone sold to him.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: His ledgers have our seal on them. I will carry that home too.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: Names in his ledger. My runners are in it. So is where he sent them.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: His ledgers. Every page is a trade.

orion.speaker: ORION
orion.text: He bought and sold. Someone was always buying from the other side.

orion2.speaker: ORION
orion2.text: Someone was always buying from the other side. You will want to watch me read these.

open.speaker: LAMPLIGHTER
open.text: Light costs. This row hasn't paid.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: A whole street in the dark, and one man with a pole.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: He puts them out one by one. As if light were his to take back.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: The Lamplighter. Runners used to pay him to leave a street dark. Tonight he's charging the other way.

trusted.speaker: ORION
trusted.text: Nothing touches him in the dark. Strike a lamp to light it, and hit him while he stands in it. I will drive him toward the light.

watched.speaker: ORION
watched.text: Nothing touches him in the dark. Light a lamp near him and strike before he puts it out. Every lamp burns down.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: Nothing touches him in the dark. Light a lamp near him and strike before he puts it out.
